effects.printed_clause: Ritual Summon any Nephthys Ritual Monster.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation selects a hand Nephthys Ritual monster summonable by Ritual, sets material and completes procedure.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Ritual Spell selection, Ritual Summon, material assignment, and CompleteProcedure structure.

effects.printed_clause: Tribute Nephthys monsters from hand/field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Ritual Monster’s Level.
effects.lua_implementation: Ritual material group is filtered to set monsters with Level >0 and legal ritual material; subgroup sum is at least required Level and releases with Ritual material reason.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Ritual material-pool and Level-sum subgroup handling.

effects.printed_clause: If you control no monsters, you may Tribute 1 Nephthys monster from Deck instead.
effects.lua_implementation: The alternative selects one Main Deck Nephthys monster that is releasable and legal Ritual Material; Main Deck monsters necessarily have a Level, and Ritual-material legality still applies to a monster Tributed for a Ritual Summon.

official_references.matched_structure: Nekroz Kaleidoscope and official Ritual Spells demonstrate nonstandard Ritual material locations.

effects.issue: Rejected: Xyz and Link Monsters cannot be in the Main Deck location named by the effect, and the word Tribute does not override effects that prohibit use as Ritual Material.

effects.printed_clause: If any card is destroyed while you control Conductor, Devotee or Priestess: banish this card from GY.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed EVENT_DESTROYED checks exact named face-up monster and aux.bfgcost.

official_references.matched_structure: Conductor of Nephthys is the exact official named Nephthys reference and uses destruction triggers.

effects.printed_clause: Destroy 1 card you control, then place a Nephthys Continuous Trap face-up from Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: Target legality ensures a destroyable own card and available Trap; when S/T zone is full it requires destroying an S/T to open one. Successful destruction gates MoveToField face-up.

official_references.matched_structure: Black Chaos places a Continuous Trap face-up from Deck/GY using MoveToField.

effects.printed_clause: The GY effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.
